atoms.b: This is Queen Victoria. She is one of the most famous ((++queens kings)) in history.
She ruled the United Kingdom for ((++63 200)) years!

atoms.a: Victoria’s father died when she was ...
atoms.sound: Victoria’s father died when she was 8 months old.

atoms.a: Victoria’s mother was very strict and ...
atoms.sound: Victoria’s mother was very strict and had lots of rules.

feedback.finish: Some of the rules included always sleeping in her mother’s bedroom, not being allowed to eat certain foods and writing in her “Behaviour Book” each day.

instruction.text: How do you think Victoria might have felt during her childhood growing up in Kensington Palace?

hint.text: Queen Victoria was an only child and had to follow lots of strict rules.

b.sound: She was happy that she had lots of other children to play with.

feedback.finish: Victoria mostly played with her governess, Baronness Lehzen, who also taught her!

instruction.text: Select the three subjects that you think Queen Victoria was taught at Kensington Palace.

feedback.end: Queen Victoria could speak French, German, Italian and even some Latin!
